title: API Keys
description: Administre sus API keys para acceso programático
createApiKeyDescription: Cree una nueva API key para acceder a la API de MetaMCP programáticamente
name: Nombre
createFirstApiKey: Cree su primera API key para comenzar
confirmDelete: ¿Está seguro de que desea eliminar esta API key?
deleteConfirmation: Esta acción no se puede deshacer. Las aplicaciones que usen esta API key perderán el acceso.
ownershipDescription: Las API keys privadas solo son visibles para usted. Las API keys públicas pueden ser usadas por cualquier persona.
createAdminOnly: Only administrators can create API keys.
scopeDescription: The key will only authenticate on the selected endpoint. "All endpoints" mints a gateway-wide key and is restricted to administrators.
actsAsUserPlaceholder: better-auth user id — leave empty for no identity
actsAsUserDescription: Optional, administrators only. Requests authenticated by this key run delegated M365 calls as this user. Requires a specific endpoint scope, and the key must be owned by this same user — never available on public ('everyone') keys. Without a binding the key stays fail-closed (no delegated identity).
adminPlaneDescription: Administrators only. Authenticates on the control plane (/trpc) as its owner, for CI and automation. Refused on the data plane. Mutually exclusive with endpoint scope and acts-as identity, and it must be owned by an administrator.
